Brunitec – Honing Solutions – Honing Tools and Machines
[![WhatsApp](https://www.brunitec.com.br/novo-brunitec/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/whatsapp52.png)](https://wa.me/5511972044991) * vendas @ brunitec.com.br * WhatsApp: +55 11 97204 4991 * Phone: +55 11 4028 9944 [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/brunimax.retificas/) [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/brunitec) [Map-marked-alt](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4PX7NcZXBj7B79W7) [![](https://www.brunitec.com.br/novo-brunitec/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/logo-brunitec-azul-en.png)](https://www.brunitec.com.br/en/home-en/) [CALL +55 (11) 4028-9944](tel:551140289944) # BRUNITEC - Honing Solution We are a Brazilian company, founded in 1992, and we operate in the market offering innovative solutions in the field of **honing machines, honing tools and diamond and Borazon honing stones**. We have ISO 9001 certification and have exported our technology to many countries since 2003. To offer solutions, **products, and services for honing** with the highest existing technology in the market, aiming to meet the specific needs of each client is our **MISSION**. ## Super Abrasives And Tools We produce **super abrasive stones** with the highest technology in **metal alloys**, **diamonds** and **CBN (Cubic Boron Nitride)**, always using raw materials from the best suppliers in the world. With rigorously tracked and controlled manufacturing processes, the sintering of our **abrasive stones** are done in **CNC** machines with controlled atmosphere, ensuring that our products are consistent **over time** and are always delivered with the best quality for customers. [Super Abrasives And Tools](../super-abrasives-and-tools/) ![](https://www.brunitec.com.br/novo-brunitec/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/hm-reguas-diamantadas-CBN.jpg) ## Honing Tools We offer our customers a line of custom-made and interchangeable tools for all types and brands of **honing machines** available in the market. With high precision in our production process, our expanding and ‘single pass’ type tools, with pneumatic measurement possibility and automatic compensation, ensure that **honed products** meet the finish, dimensional, and technical specifications within customer requirements. Our customer focus ensures that each **machine** is precisely tailored to your needs, providing not only greater **productivity** and **savings** but also exceptional **durability**. Built to handle a wide variety of materials and production volumes, **Brunitec** machines offer a reliable and efficient solution for all your **honing** demands. [Horizontal Machines](../horizontal-honing-machines/)[Vertical Machines](../vertical-honing-machines/)[Reformed Machines](../reformed-machines-retrofiting/) **Honing** is an **abrasive** machining process that provides precise geometry and stable control of the surface roughness of the finished material. [Honing Process](https://www.brunitec.com.br/novo-brunitec/en/what-is-the-honing-process/) ![](https://www.brunitec.com.br/novo-brunitec/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/tp-inst05.jpg) We perform replacement and regrinding services for **honing** stones and carbide guides, as well as adjustments and calibration on **honing tools**.
